greet.speaker: Hermit
greet.text: You've come to the old shrine. Few do, these days.
greet.text_zh: 你來到了這座古老的神社。如今很少有人會來這裡了。

choices.text_zh: 是什麼東西在守護這裡？

warning.speaker: Hermit
warning.text: A guardian sleeps in the cave beyond. Face it with care, and the relic may yet be yours.
warning.text_zh: 有一位守護者沉睡在前方的洞窟中。小心應對，遺物或許還是屬於你的。
